findings.title: Admin members actions read :group_id but route supplies :id
findings.body: In app/controllers/admin/groups_controller.rb add_members (and remove_member at line 85) does Group.find(params.require(:group_id).to_i). In config/routes.rb the routes are declared as member routes inside resources :groups (delete "members", put "members"), so the URL /admin/groups/:id/members.json supplies params[:id], not params[:group_id]. The JS calls /admin/groups/<id>/members.json, so the controller will raise ActionController::ParameterMissing and adding/removing members via the UI will always fail with 400. Controller specs pass only because they inject group_id directly and bypass routing.

findings.title: Unbounded limit/offset on group members endpoint
findings.body: In app/controllers/groups_controller.rb GroupsController#members does limit = (params[:limit] || 50).to_i with no maximum and no validation of offset. A caller can request limit=1000000 (or negative values) causing order/limit/offset over a large users table, loading huge result sets into memory and serializing them. This is a denial-of-service / performance risk; the limit should be clamped to a sane maximum and negative/non-numeric values rejected.

findings.title: totalPages off-by-one for exact multiples
findings.body: In app/assets/javascripts/admin/controllers/admin-group.js.es6 totalPages is Math.floor(user_count / limit) + 1. When user_count is an exact multiple of limit (e.g. 50/50, 100/50) this reports one extra page (2 instead of 1, 3 instead of 2). Combined with next using Math.min(offset+limit, user_count), the admin can paginate to an empty last page and showingLast never becomes true on the real last page.

findings.title: Adding members fails when usernames contain spaces
findings.body: In app/controllers/admin/groups_controller.rb add_members does usernames.split(",").each with User.find_by_username(username) and no strip. The user-selector sends comma-separated values that commonly contain spaces after commas (e.g. "bob, alice"). The second lookup becomes " alice" with a leading space and will not match, so only the first user is added and the rest are silently ignored with a success response.

findings.title: Update unconditionally clears visible when param omitted
findings.body: In app/controllers/admin/groups_controller.rb update does group.visible = params[:visible] == "true" without checking presence. If a client updates only alias_level or name and omits visible, visible is forced to false and saved, unintentionally hiding the group. The assignment should only run when params[:visible] is present.

findings.title: Spec uses wrong verb and masks routing param bug
findings.body: In spec/controllers/admin/groups_controller_spec.rb the remove_member test does xhr :put, :remove_member while config/routes.rb defines delete "members" => "groups#remove_member". The specs also pass group_id directly, so they never exercise the real /admin/groups/:id/members route. The suite therefore cannot catch the :group_id vs :id mismatch or a verb mismatch, and gives false confidence that member add/remove works.
